feedback_dispatch_event_required_check.name: feedback_dispatch_event_required_check
feedback_dispatch_event_required_check.value: ("feedback"."dispatch_status" = 'not_required' AND "feedback"."dispatch_event_id" IS NULL) OR ("feedback"."dispatch_status" <> 'not_required' AND "feedback"."dispatch_event_id" IS NOT NULL)

interview_session_terminal_reason_state_.name: interview_session_terminal_reason_state_check
interview_session_terminal_reason_state_.value: ("interview_session"."lifecycle_state" IN ('ending', 'completed', 'abandoned', 'failed') AND "interview_session"."terminal_reason" IS NOT NULL) OR ("interview_session"."lifecycle_state" NOT IN ('ending', 'completed', 'abandoned', 'failed') AND "interview_session"."terminal_reason" IS NULL)

interview_session_room_provisioning_clai.name: interview_session_room_provisioning_claim_check
interview_session_room_provisioning_clai.value: ("interview_session"."room_provisioning_pending" AND "interview_session"."room_provisioning_started_at" IS NOT NULL) OR (NOT "interview_session"."room_provisioning_pending" AND "interview_session"."room_provisioning_started_at" IS NULL)

interview_session_reconnect_deadline_own.name: interview_session_reconnect_deadline_owner_check
interview_session_reconnect_deadline_own.value: ("interview_session"."reconnect_deadline_at" IS NULL AND "interview_session"."reconnect_deadline_owner" IS NULL) OR ("interview_session"."reconnect_deadline_at" IS NOT NULL AND "interview_session"."reconnect_deadline_owner" IN ('reconnect_grace', 'hard_deadline'))

interview_session_deadline_room_cleanup_.name: interview_session_deadline_room_cleanup_ack_check
interview_session_deadline_room_cleanup_.value: ("interview_session"."deadline_room_cleanup_status" IN ('deleted', 'already_absent') AND "interview_session"."deadline_room_cleanup_acknowledged_at" IS NOT NULL) OR ("interview_session"."deadline_room_cleanup_status" IS NULL OR "interview_session"."deadline_room_cleanup_status" = 'pending') AND "interview_session"."deadline_room_cleanup_acknowledged_at" IS NULL

transcript_turn_session_writer_sequence_.name: transcript_turn_session_writer_sequence_idx
transcript_turn_session_writer_sequence_.where: "transcript_turn"."writer_id" IS NOT NULL AND "transcript_turn"."sequence" IS NOT NULL

transcript_turn_canonical_identity_check.name: transcript_turn_canonical_identity_check
transcript_turn_canonical_identity_check.value:
(
        "transcript_turn"."contract_version" IS NULL AND
        "transcript_turn"."event_id" IS NULL AND
        "transcript_turn"."writer_id" IS NULL AND
        "transcript_turn"."sequence" IS NULL AND
        "transcript_turn"."room_name" IS NULL AND
        "transcript_turn"."delivery_state" IS NULL
      ) OR (
        "transcript_turn"."contract_version" = 2 AND
        "transcript_turn"."event_id" IS NOT NULL AND
        "transcript_turn"."writer_id" IS NOT NULL AND
        "transcript_turn"."sequence" IS NOT NULL AND
        "transcript_turn"."room_name" IS NOT NULL AND
        "transcript_turn"."started_at" IS NOT NULL AND
        "transcript_turn"."ended_at" IS NOT NULL AND
        "transcript_turn"."text" IS NOT NULL AND
        "transcript_turn"."audio_ms" IS NOT NULL AND
        "transcript_turn"."section" IS NOT NULL AND
        "transcript_turn"."delivery_state" IS NOT NULL
      )
